rc_beetle_exoskeleton_tpu.structural_purpose: Variable-density trabecular outer RC shell bumper [1.1]. Executed with 25% Gyroid infill within a 3-wall skinned TPU chassis to damp concrete drop shock forces across internal math curves without splitting [1.1].

rc_rigid_spine_and_cups_nacf.structural_purpose: Rigid internal motor spine and outer female axle slider cups [1.1]. Hard-coded to a fine 0.12mm height and 100% solid concentric toolpaths in Carbon-Fiber Nylon to guarantee the internal 3.2mm square keyways hold absolute flat walls that never strip under motor torque [1.1, 1.2].

rc_telescoping_shafts_pp.structural_purpose: Ductile inner male sliding axle shafts. Sliced in chemical-resistant Polypropylene (PP) to absorb sudden rotational gear shock during jump landings while sliding freely inside the female keyways [1.1, 1.2].
